description: Slice one prepared wallpaper canvas into seamless per-display crops at each monitor's true physical position, then set each display's wallpaper by id.

displays.description: List every display (id, name, origin, size) and its seamless crop window, plus the arrangement bounding box (= the size your canvas must be).

seam-check.description: Reconstruct the physical desk from the canvas (crops composited at their positions, edges outlined) to verify seamlessness before applying. Writes a preview PNG.

args.name: canvas
args.description: Prepared canvas, sized to the arrangement bbox

apply.description: Carve the canvas into per-display timestamped crops and set each as wallpaper. Pass name=WxH+X+Y to override a physically-separated screen (e.g. a prompter); --no-set to carve only; --resize to cover-crop a mis-sized canvas. Records a wallpaper-set.conf so the set can be replayed with apply-set.

args.name: canvas
args.description: Prepared canvas, sized to the arrangement bbox

args.name: out-dir
args.description: Where crops are written (default: canvas's folder)

apply-set.description: Apply a saved wallpaper set by folder name (a subfolder of ~/Pictures/wallpaper) or path. Reads the set's recorded canvas + overrides from wallpaper-set.conf. Use this to swap wallpapers or recover after a reboot.

args.name: set
args.description: Set folder name (e.g. goldengate) or a path to the set folder
